Dear Rahul Sharma,

Thank you for reaching out to ELEMENTAL CONCEPT. I sincerely apologize to hear that the Laptop Charger you received for Order ID ORD1001 is damaged. This is certainly not the quality experience we aim to provide.

Given your report of receiving the item today and the previous communication regarding its transit, we will proceed with a replacement for you. The Laptop Charger (PROD001) is eligible for replacement as per our policy.

To arrange this, we will schedule a pick-up for the damaged Laptop Charger at your convenience. Once the damaged item is collected, we will dispatch a new replacement to you immediately.

I have updated your existing investigation ticket (INV-C44E28B6) with this new issue and the details of the replacement process. We will contact you shortly to coordinate the pick-up.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we resolve this for you.

Best regards,
ELEMENTAL CONCEPT Customer Support
